# Load order: TGR -> ... -> E&F -> E&F Hotfix -> ... -> Grey's pack -> THIS.
# Why this file exists: E&F adds its two financial PM groups with INJECT:. Five buildings are then re-declared with full bodies by grey_food / grey_food_2_ranch / grey_usu, which load later, and a full body wins over an earlier INJECT -- so the groups are gone and those buildings drop out of E&F's economy entirely (no liquidity, no stock, no private-ownership switching), with nothing in error.log. TRY_INJECT: so a building renamed in a future Grey's version does not spam the log. building_railway is NOT here on purpose: its body has to be merged with the LLWA addon's (GR.9 / GR.16 / GR.17), and two compatches must not REPLACE one record.

# what each building loses and to whose body:
#   building_food_industry     REPLACE_OR_CREATE:   mog_food_industry.txt              <- ef_01_industry.txt
#   building_livestock_ranch   REPLACE_OR_CREATE:   mog_ranch.txt                      <- ef_02_agro.txt
#   building_port              REPLACE_OR_CREATE:   yMoG_USU_ports_coastal.txt         <- ef_11_private_infrastructure.txt
#   building_power_plant       REPLACE:             yMoG_USU_PPP_power_plant.txt       <- ef_06_urban_center.txt
#   building_trade_center      REPLACE_OR_CREATE:   yMoG_USU_trade_center.txt          <- ef_11_private_infrastructure.txt
